statement: After extension-port status, Dolphin clears Nunchuk/Classic and MotionPlus state, invalidates the report-mode cache and infers or re-reads active A400FA identity. For inactive MotionPlus it polls A600FE length 1, initializes A600F0=55 and writes desired A600FE mode 04/05/07. Mode writes set the current mode unknown, wait two seconds, and trigger active-mode rechecks; status and MP embedded extension-connectivity events can restart this cycle. Failed initialization can defer or retry, not prove that a single write achieved a stable gyro stream.
